full_page.content:
Page 53
Mar. 23rd Mary J. Brinker - 18 - Rt. 3 Mt. Clemens - head-cancer - most mali- gnant sarcoma - has not yet touched brain, but so near it that "science stands agast at outlook for patient". Drs. recon she may live three months, but only a miracle can help.
23rs Mrs. Catherine Koch - 72 - fearful eczma and itch ever since first week in January - enrolls Today perpetually .... and Poor Souls ....
Mrs. Ann Pepin - 62 - auto-accid. five years ago on way to Florida and is still in lamentible condition - fearful pain.
Mrs. Mary Sherman - 72 - Eye and strok also threatened with cancer of breast.
Frank DeRonge - 37 - double pneumonia - in Deaconess Hosp.
Page 54 Mar. 26 Constantine Toman - 17 - pneumonia since a week tomorrow. Enrolled To-day by 1.00 presbiterian - Miss Chloe Hardy.
26 Andrew Wheeler of 686 Manistique, Det. - 36 - Methodist - Operation on brain tuomer Febr. 23 - improved for time then infection set in ... operated again March 12 - Enrolled March 23rd when things were quite threatening ..... Came home next day - day before yesterday, is here To-day thankful that he feels again "Normal" except a little weak. Drs. in Ann arbor - Peet & Wood - call it miraculous that a patient should talk intelligently four days after such an operation ..... Deo Gratias Oct. 18, 1944 Thank God .... Both Mr. & Mrs. here To-day. He has recently started reading .. "City of God" and is de- cidedly hopeful of entire recovery - is enthused at same.
Mrs. Alice Roshak - 47 - deformed back ever since infancy, which however never bothered her till she fell off a ladder in 9 yrs. ago, has two sons in service and husband who cares little and drinks .... Enrolled To-day, 2nd time.
Mrs. Uller (Jacqlelwicz) - Elderly - (60) - wants some one to stay in house with her - $3. per day - 20251 Stotter - Tw 15807 winbrook - take Harper Car out Van Dyke to 8 mile.
Page 55 Mar.
? . . . . Review May 21 - '52 Eve of Ascension
Case of Andy Wheeler March 23 - 26 1943 - Introduced by (Elder) Catholic (Mrs. ? ) when he was still unconscious in hospital, his wife weeping promised: "I'll do anything to please the Lord , if He only spares my poor, dear Husband." Never heard from them after a week or so till October 16th 1944 and two days later when he was in perfect health.
